items.title: Vision-Language-Action Autonomous Driving Agent with Language-based Memory
items.topic: Vision-Language-Action Autonomous Driving Agent with Language-based Memory
items.summary: The Vision-Language-Action (VLA) foundation models, developed by researchers, address the memory limitations of existing VLA models in autonomous driving. AD-Memo, the proposed agent, uses language-based memory to enhance interpretability and portability, crucial for tasks like determining arrival order at all-way stops and long-horizon driving scene understanding. This advancement is significant for improving the reliability and explainability of autonomous driving systems.

items.title: Learning to Explain While Planning: Rule-Aligned Diffusion Planning for Autonomous Driving
items.topic: Learning to Explain While Planning: Rule-Aligned Diffusion Planning for Autonomous Driving
items.summary: Researchers propose Rule-Aligned Diffusion Planning, a method that integrates driving rules into the trajectory generation process of diffusion planners. This approach ensures that trajectories are not only statistically sound but also rule-compliant, enhancing safety and interpretability. The method addresses the limitations of existing planners that lack rule-level explanations, making it a critical advancement for autonomous driving safety and validation.

items.title: Comparative study of adapting pre-trained models for driving behavior video captioning
items.topic: Comparative study of adapting pre-trained models for driving behavior video captioning
items.summary: A study by researchers compares various fine-tuning and prompting methods for adapting Large Language Models (LLMs) to driving behavior video captioning. The study, using the BDD-X dataset, demonstrates that full fine-tuning of SpaceTimeGPT outperforms the baseline in several automatic metrics. The research also explores the limitations of Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) and prompt engineering on the VideoLLaVA model, providing insights into the effective use of LLMs in autonomous driving.
